gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall favourable prior-year reserve movement in 2024, with a gross release of GBP 12.5m (5.8% of opening gross claims outstanding). The release was driven by improvements across casualty (GBP 7.7m), property (GBP 3.4m) and marine (GBP 1.4m) reinsurance business, reflecting favourable claims development on those lines. Hurricane Ian (Sept 2022) is noted elsewhere in the report as a major loss in prior years, but the movement disclosed in the prior-year provision note is an aggregate improvement across several classes.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and gross premiums taken from the Statement of Financial Position and Note 2 respectively (amounts presented in GBP '000 in the report and converted to millions). The 'Movement in prior year's provision' note gives an aggregate improvement (GBP 12.5m) which is used as the gross prior-year development; the note's wording does not explicitly label the figure 'gross' but it is the Movement in prior years' provisions note and is treated as gross. The premium-class labels for the gross premium mix were inferred from the technical provisions/notes where class labels appear and matched to the numeric rows in Note 2 (the note's numeric rows sum to the total gross premiums written), therefore confidence is reduced for exact class mapping.
